wiki.title: General Wugashima
wiki.text:
General Wugashima is a chugawug enemy NPC that appears on a mountaintop located south of Wugachug during the quests Countering the Calvary and Elf Ex Machina. He is the general of the Flying Pig Dogo Ninjawugs, and one of Raven's minions while influenced by the Gloam throughout the Bugawug Queen quest series.

Ninjawug Outpost
Ninjawug Outpost is a difficulty 2 battle available during the quest Ex Elf Machina.

thumb|Gloam obilisk
During the quest named Elf Ex Machina, the player is sent to stop General Wugashima who is preparing a ninjawug attack on Wugachug by the order of Bixie Queen, Raven. During the first confrontation with General Wugashima, he claims the player's arrival was expected and begins attacking. Once defeated, he summons Ninjawugs of the Flying Pig Dojo to attack, and continues to respawn the Ninjawugs after defeat until a Gloam obilisk is destroyed by Chugzy.

Once the Gloam obilisk is destroyed, General Wugashima is no longer under the influence of Queen Raven and becomes an ally.
